%description: Curated map of an item's `classification` path to { name (singular display label), category (plural browse category) }, curated like types.json — the API's generated classification_label is NOT used. Module:Entity/Data.resolveType resolves items to the most-specific matching Ship.* prefix; unmapped paths (FPS.*, absent, or unknown) fall back to types.json[type]. Grouping levels (Ship.Weapon, Ship.Turret) are listed so finer entries nest under them on-wiki. There is intentionally no top-level `Ship` key, so an unmapped single-segment path (e.g. `Ship.SomethingNew`) falls back to types.json rather than landing in a catch-all bucket. Extend with new distinct Ship.* classifications as they appear; fallback makes partial coverage safe.
